entities.summary: Count Leonardo Bonzi was a lawyer, aviator, soldier, filmmaker, tennis player, and bobsledder, member of the Bonzi family and renowned for his sporting achievements and film career. He participated in major transatlantic flights, including the 1948 Atlantic crossing with the aircraft "Grifo," and co-directed the documentary film Lost Continent, which won the Special Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival in 1955. He served as a pilot during World War II, receiving the Gold Medal and three Silver Medals of Military Valor.
